_doc: Synthetic listing titles (fictional brands, written for these tests; no Amazon content) and the lane the examples/home-power.site.yaml rules must give them. expect: a lane id, 'reject' (global rule `rule`), 'off-lane', or 'held:<lane>' (a phase-2 lane, held back). nodes are browse-node ids; confidence is checked when given. The year-1 cord cases are priced at $150-200 too, where the station lane's floors no longer turn them away first: only a GLOBAL reject stops them.
